en: A vintage postcard featuring a romantic, classical-style painting of a young couple. The woman, wrapped in a translucent draped cloth, stands against a stone wall decorated with blooming flowers while a young man leans over the wall, whispering into her ear. The background suggests an outdoor, lush garden or park setting. There is a vertical white section to the right with text in Russian, German, and English, identifying the artist and title.
